हॉलीवुड में Ana de Armas की लव लाइफ के चर्चे हमेशा से आग लगाते रहे हैं! 🔥

जानें क्या है Tom Cruise और Ben Affleck के साथ उनके रिश्तों में अजीब समानता।

Ben Affleck के साथ Ana de Armas की मुलाकात 2019 में Deep Water के सेट पर हुई थी।

पैंडेमिक के दौरान दोनों लॉस एंजिल्स में साथ दिखे और एक्ट्रेस ने उनके घर में भी समय बिताया।

People रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक, जनवरी 2021 में एक साल से कम समय में दोनों अलग हो गए और ब्रेकअप Ana de Armas ने शुरू किया था।

दूसरी तरफ, Tom Cruise के साथ उनके रिश्ते की खबरें फरवरी 2025 में लंदन में साथ दिखने पर शुरू हुईं।

Us Weekly के मुताबिक, अक्टूबर 2025 तक उनका रिश्ता खत्म हो गया और अंदरूनी सूत्रों का दावा है कि रिश्ता उम्मीद से ज्यादा तेजी से बढ़ने पर Ana de Armas ने कदम पीछे खींच लिए।

वहीं People के करीबी सूत्र का दावा है कि Cruise उनके केवल दोस्त और मेंटोर हैं और वह कुछ समय से सिंगल थीं।

खास बात यह है कि दोनों मामलों में सूत्रों का दावा है कि Ana de Armas ने ही रिश्ता खत्म करने का फैसला किया!

ctx.text:
Ana de Armas has had two of Hollywood’s biggest leading men linked to her love life, and neither story ended quite the way fans expected. With Ben Affleck, there were romantic vacations, endless paparazzi pictures, and a relationship that became serious enough for family introductions.
And with Tom Cruise, there were reportedly helicopter rides and secretive outings. Yet, despite the excitement surrounding both relationships, neither lasted.
Now, if we take a closer look at how both the relationships allegedly ended, there’s one uncomfortable similarity between the relationships.
Ana de Armas & Ben Affleck reportedly first met in 2019 on the set of Deep Water , and within a year, the two were spotted enjoying vacations in Cuba and Costa Rica. Particularly during the pandemic, their relationship became more prominent. From coffee runs to dog walking, the duo was spotted many times in Los Angeles.
Things appeared to get quite serious pretty quickly. The actress reportedly moved into Affleck’s Los Angeles home and spent time with his family as well. Unfortunately, in January 2021, news broke that the couple had called it quits after spending less than a year together. According to People , de Armas initiated the breakup.
Ana de Armas’ rumored relationship with Tom Cruise began making headlines in February 2025 when the two were spotted together in London around Valentine’s Day. Initially, their meeting was described as a professional discussion about potential projects.
However, their frequent appearances together soon made fans wonder whether something more was happening. Over the following months, the actors were photographed arriving together at a London heliport, enjoying dinners, and spending time together around de’ Armas’ birthday. By May, Us Weekly reported that Cruise and de Armas were quietly dating.
However, by October 2025, reports suggested their rumored romance had ended. The Sun claimed that the two had decided they were better suited to friendship after their romantic spark faded.
Us Weekly also reported a slightly different explanation, and according to an insider, de Armas was the one who stepped back because the relationship was progressing faster than she expected. However, People published an account from a source close to de Armas and described Cruise as a friend and mentor, and claimed she had been single for some time.
Despite their different circumstances, the reported endings of Ana de Armas ’ relationships with Ben Affleck and Tom Cruise shared one particularly interesting detail: in both cases, sources claimed that de Armas was the person who decided to step away.
Both her relationships followed the same pattern: they began as professional connections and ultimately became hot topics in Hollywood. But it’s still unclear why both of her high-profile relationships ended the same way and in a similar timeline.
